chapter: Learning trumpet and first bands in New Orleans
title: Alfred's story of the lights going out on the boat band
summary: Alfred tells how the Piron boat band's players, who read only from music, could not play when the lights went out, naming those who could not play by ear.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
